title: Perspectives in Human-Technology Frontier
description: Engineering concepts/solutions enabled by advances in intelligent technology and integration with human skills to improve economic and social well-being of self and society. Technology solutions to everyday physiological and psychological challenges.

title: Engineering Orientation and Career Exploration
description: Introduction to specific fields of engineering interest; explore successful student practice; preview of major and career options; interaction with faculty, campus resources, students, and staff; explore realistic career options based on major choice; prepare for academic success.
notes: See Class Schedule for appropriate section based on your program enrollment such as MESA or other.

title: Introduction to Renewable Energy
description: Energy sources and systems. Future challenges and trends of energy use. Incentives and policies on energy resources. Laws of thermodynamics and factors impacting economic viability of power generation.

title: Internship/Practicum
description: Supervised internship or practicum experience with approval of graduate adviser. Not applicable to an advanced degree.

title: Project
description: Preparation of a project for the master’s degree.

title: Project Extension
description: Registration required in any semester or term following assignment of RP in Course 799A in which the student expects to use the facilities and resources of the university; also student must be registered in the course when the completed project is granted final approval.

title: Comprehensive Examination Extension
description: Registration required of students whose only requirement is completion of the comprehensive examination for the master’s degree.

title: Doctoral Research
description: Independent research in general areas of applied mechanics. Content to be determined after consultation with adviser.

title: Doctoral Special Study
description: Individual study leading to study and research required for doctoral dissertation.

title: Doctoral Dissertation
description: Final research and preparation of dissertation for doctoral degree. Enrollment required during term in which dissertation is approved.
